rendering: Lossless WebP. Magenta colour key becomes transparent in the game renderer; nearest-neighbor filtering.
prompts: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: the actual controllable full-body 2D pixel-art game sprite for GehstockMon, a dark fantasy exploration game. Edit target: the attached existing player character. Transform this same hooded male wanderer into authentic crisp 16-bit RPG pixel art, with chunky square pixel clusters on a consistent approximately 80x100 logical pixel grid, not a detailed illustration with a pixel filter. Preserve his recognizable teal hood and long teal coat, golden scarf and brass trim, short dark beard, leather backpack, sturdy brown boots and curved golden walking cane. Single complete character from hood to soles and cane tip, large readable head/body proportions suitable for a tiny in-game sprite. Three-quarter front view facing slightly toward screen left, mild overhead RPG viewpoint, neutral standing stance with both boots visible. Centered with about 6 percent empty padding, soles aligned horizontally near the bottom. The background must be genuinely transparent alpha, a clean cutout. No background color, no checkerboard drawn into the image, no scenery, no floor, no shadow, no border or portrait card, no text, no watermark. Use a restrained rich palette, dark pixel outline and 3-4 hard-edged tones per material. All edges visibly staircase-shaped and sharply square; no antialiasing, blur, gradients or 3D render lighting. Output one square transparent PNG sprite asset, not a sprite sheet, not multiple poses.

Edit target: the supplied pixel-art wanderer sprite. Preserve the entire character exactly: silhouette, pixel blocks, face, teal coat, gold scarf, boots, walking cane and all their colors. Change ONLY the background. Replace every gray/white checkerboard background pixel outside the character, including gaps between legs and between the walking cane and body, with a single perfectly flat fully saturated magenta RGB(255,0,255), hex #FF00FF. The flat magenta is a technical chroma-key backdrop for a game engine. No checkerboard, no pattern, no texture, no lighting, no variation, no shadows on the backdrop. Hard crisp pixel silhouette boundary; no soft fringe. Keep the same single full-body left-facing sprite, square canvas, centered composition and size. This is background cleanup only; do not redesign the character.
